text:
The Exaltation of the Holy Cross by Father Francis Xavier Weninger, DD, SJ, 1876.
.
This festival was instituted in commemoration of the day on which the holy Cross of Christ, was, with great solemnities, brought back to Jerusalem. Chosroes, king of Persia, had invaded Syria with a powerful army, and had conquered Jerusalem, the capital. He caused the massacre of eighty thousand men, and also took many prisoners away with him, among whom was the Patriarch Zachary. But more painful than all this to the Christians was, that he carried away the holy, Cross of our Saviour, which, after great pains, had been discovered by the holy empress, St. Helena. The pagan king carried it with him to Persia, adorned it magnificently with pearls and precious stones, and placed it upon the top of his royal throne of pure gold. Thus was the holy Cross held in higher honor by the heathen king, than Martin Luther would have manifested; for, in one of his sermons, he says of it: "If a piece of the holy Cross were given to me and I had it in my hand, I would soon put it where the sun would never shine on it."
.
Heraclius, the pious emperor, was greatly distressed at this misfortune, and as he had not an army sufficiently large to meet so powerful an enemy, he made propositions for peace. Chosroes, inflated by many victories, refused at first to listen to the emperor's proposal, but at length consented, on condition that Heraclius should forsake the faith of Christ and worship the Sun, the god of the Persians. Indignant at so wicked a request, the emperor, seeing that it was a question of religion, concerning the honor of the Most High, broke off all negotiation with his impious enemy. Taking refuge in prayer, he assembled all the Christian soldiers of his dominions, and commanded all his subjects to appease the wrath of the Almighty, and ask for His assistance, by fasting, praying, giving alms and other good works. He himself gave them the example. After this, he went courageously, with his comparatively small army, to meet the haughty Chosroes, having given strict orders that his soldiers, besides abstaining from other vices, should avoid all plundering and blaspheming, that they might prove themselves worthy of the divine assistance.
.
Taking a crucifix in his hand, he animated his soldiers by pointing towards it, saying they should consider for whose honor they were fighting, and that there was nothing more glorious than to meet death for the honor of God and His holy religion. Thus strengthened, the Christian army marched against the enemy. Three times were they attacked by three divisions of the Persian army, each one led by an experienced general; and three times they repulsed the enemy, so that Chosroes himself had at last to flee. His eldest son, Siroes, whom he had excluded from the succession to the throne, seized the opportunity, and not only assassinated his own father, but also his brother, Medarses, who had been chosen by Chosroes as his associate and successor. To secure the crown which he had thus forcibly seized, Siroes offered peace to Heraclius, restored to him the conquered provinces, and also sent back the holy Cross, the patriarch Zachary, and all the other prisoners of war. Heraclius, in great joy, hastened with the priceless wood to Jerusalem, to offer due thanks to the Almighty for the victory, and to restore the holy Cross, which the Persians had kept in their possession during fourteen years, to its former place.
.
All the inhabitants of the city, the clergy and laity, came to meet the pious emperor. The latter had resolved to carry the Cross to Mount Calvary, to the church fitted up for its reception. A solemn procession was formed, in which the Patriarch, the courtiers and an immense multitude of people took part. The clergy preceded, and the emperor, arrayed in sumptuous robes of state, carried the holy Cross upon his shoulder. Having thus passed through the city, they came to the gate that leads to Calvary, when suddenly the emperor stood still and could not move from the spot. At this miracle, all became frightened, not knowing what to think of it. Only to St. Zachary did God reveal the truth. Turning to the emperor the patriarch said: "Christ was not arrayed in splendor when He bore His Cross through this gate. His brow was not adorned with a golden crown, but with one made of thorns. Perhaps, O emperor, your magnificent robe is the cause of your detention."
.
The pious Heraclius humbly gave ear to the words of the patriarch, divested himself of his imperial purple, and put on poor apparel, he took the crown from his head and the shoes from his feet. Having done this, the sacred treasure was again laid on his shoulder: when, behold! nothing detained him, and he carried it to the place of its destination. The holy patriarch then deposited the Cross in its former place, and duly venerated it with all who were present. God manifested how much He was pleased with the honor they had paid to the holy Cross of Christ, by many miracles wrought on the same day. A dead man was restored to life by being touched by the sacred wood; four paralytic persons obtained the use of their limbs; fifteen who were blind received sight; many sick recovered their health; and several possessed were freed from the devil by devoutly touching it.
.
PRACTICAL CONSIDERATIONS.
.
I. The Cross on which Christ had died was raised and greatly honored by all the faithful. I suppose that if you possessed a particle of the true Cross, you would greatly honor and cherish it. But why do you not love and honor that cross, those trials which God sends you? They are, in a spiritual sense, a particle of the Cross of Christ, which will be most beneficial to you, if you bear it patiently. Christ, the Lord, called His crucifixion an exaltation, saying: "The Son of Man must be exalted; "because by it He was exalted in heaven and on earth, as He bore His sufferings and His death out of love for His heavenly Father and for the salvation of men. You also will be exalted in heaven, if, in carrying your cross, you follow the example of Christ. Many carry their crosses, like the thief on the left of Christ, with murmuring and impatience, others, like the one on His right, with patience and resignation, knowing that they deserve them. Jesus carried His Cross not only with patience, but, according to the words of the Apostle, with joy, although He was innocent. With whom do you carry yours? With whom will you carry it in future? If you carry it with the first, you will not be exalted, but precipitated into the depth of hell.

Hangzhou Open (ATP 250)

 Kyrian Jacquet vs Tomas Martin Etcheverry

Round of 16 · Outdoor hard · 07:30 local

🧠 Form & Context

Kyrian Jacquet

📈 The raw form lead: His CFS is 61.1 against 50.8, a 10.3-point advantage despite an even 5–5 last ten.

🎾 A surface number that needs context: His last-52-week ATP hard record is only 2–4. The 71.4% blended hard figure (20–8) relies heavily on Challenger and ITF results, so it is not a validated ATP-level edge.

✅ A useful local result: He came through a completed three-set opener against Aleksandar Vukic, 7–6(5), 3–6, 6–3.

⚠️ The class and durability tests: He is 0–3 against top-50 opponents over the last 52 weeks. His 2026 collapse rate is 24.1% (7/29), and the supplied history records three retirements across the recent seasons.

Tomas Martin Etcheverry

🏆 The stronger tour-level résumé: A maiden ATP title in 2026 and a 13–0 last-52-week record against players outside the top 100 give him a clear class argument.

📉 No commanding hard-court form: His last-52-week ATP hard record stands at 12–13; his last ten overall is also 5–5.

🕒 A rhythm question: The supplied review flags a 19-day break since his last hard-court match. That makes the early start an additional uncertainty.

🔒 Better lead protection: His 2026 collapse rate is 19.0% (4/21), compared with Jacquet's 24.1%. Neither number settles the matchup alone.

🔍 Match Breakdown

Jacquet has a real route to competing: he has already played and won a tight match at this venue, while Etcheverry brings an extended break and a merely even recent ATP hard record. A long match would allow Jacquet's current rhythm and overall results to matter.

The central limitation is the level behind Jacquet's surface score. His 20–8 blended hard record includes a large lower-tier contribution, whereas Etcheverry's opposition profile and ATP title offer a firmer measure of performance at this level. Jacquet's weak top-50 return and higher collapse rate keep us from treating the 10.3-point CFS lead as a clean underdog endorsement. The first set should tell us more about Etcheverry's sharpness than the raw ranking gap does.

🔮 Prediction

Etcheverry has the stronger route through class and lead protection, but his hard-court record and time away leave space for Jacquet to make this competitive.

text:
You've got the causation exactly backwards, so let's fix that first and then get to who actually approved these taxes.

California isn't expensive because it needs money. 

It's expensive because 39 million people and half the world's tech industry want to live in the same 100 miles of coastline and bid the housing up. 

The gap between California and Texas in taxes is a few percentage points of income. 

You said: "They can't fund themselves" 

California sends about $650 billion a year to Washington and gets less back per person than it pays. 

It funds itself and Mississippi. The states that literally can't fund themselves without money from somewhere else are the ones getting $1.50 to $2.00 back per dollar. 

You've described the donor as the dependent.

Now the part you'll like least: Californians keep voting for these taxes. 

On purpose. By name.

Prop 30 (2012) — the 13.3% top income tax rate on millionaires. Voters passed it 55–45. Prop 55 (2016) extended it to 2030 — passed 63–37. Marin, San Francisco, and Santa Clara — where the millionaires actually live — voted yes.

Prop 63 (2004) — the 1% millionaire's tax for mental health. Voter-approved.

Prop 56 (2016) — $2-a-pack tobacco tax. 64% yes.
Prop 6 (2018) — a ballot measure to repeal the gas tax increase. Voters rejected the repeal 57–43. They were offered lower gas taxes and said no thanks.

Measure M (2016) — LA County's half-cent transit sales tax. 71% yes. Measure H (2017), the homelessness sales tax — 69% yes.

Props 1 and 2 (2024) — $6.4 billion mental health bond and $10 billion school bond. Both passed.

And it cuts the other way, which is the point: California voters can reject taxes and do. 

Prop 13 (1978) capped property taxes at 1% and required a two-thirds legislative vote for any state tax increase — the strictest anti-tax rule in the country, still in force. 

Prop 30 (2022), a new tax on income over $2 million, went down 58–42. 

Every local sales tax, parcel tax, and school bond in California has to go on a ballot. 

This is the hardest state in the country to raise a tax in without asking the people paying it — which means every tax you're calling "extreme" is one that survived a public vote.

True democracy. 

So the picture isn't a state "held up" by taxes it extracts from unwilling citizens. 

It's the fourth-largest economy on Earth whose residents periodically walk into a booth and vote to tax themselves to pay for transit, schools, and mental health, and periodically vote not to when they think it's too much. 

That's not a failed state. That's the thing the founders called self-government, working roughly as designed, in a place rich enough to afford it.

Maybe broke ass Red Sates could learn alot from th 4th largest economy in the world.

The O2 & Botanical Lounge: A Next-Gen Social Wellness Club

This concept reimagines nightlife and social gathering by completely replacing alcohol with a synergistic blend of cannabinoid mixology, specialized oxygen therapy, and bio-optimized socialization. Designed as a globally scalable model for progressive legal markets (such as California, Colorado, Switzerland, Germany, and Uruguay), the flagship venue serves as the high-energy, accessible entry point into a deeper ecosystem of holistic biohacking.

The Flagship Draw: The Oxygen & Cannabis Lounge
Positioned as a direct, sophisticated alternative to a high-end cocktail bar, this space offers a "clean high" with zero hangover. It combines the relaxing, euphoric effects of cannabis with the alertness and cellular recovery of recreational oxygen therapy.

The O2 & Terpene Bar: Instead of beer taps, the bar features sleek, futuristic oxygen concentrators. Guests receive personal, comfortable nasal cannulas delivering 90%+ pure oxygen infused with specific cannabis-derived terpenes (e.g., Limonene for energy, Linalool for relaxation). This creates an immediate, lucid, and refreshing sensory experience.

Botanical Mixology: The "bartenders" are wellness mixologists serving zero-proof, craft cocktails infused with precision-dosed water-soluble cannabinoids (THC, CBD, CBG). These elixirs are functionally elevated with applied mycology extracts (like Lion's Mane for cognition or Cordyceps for energy) and natural mineral complexes, including Ormus, creating drinks that actively enhance neurological function rather than impairing it.

Vapor Sommeliers: For inhalation, the lounge utilizes high-end, medical-grade vaporization hardware (like glass gravity infusers or desktop vaporizers) brought to the table. Sommeliers guide guests through "flights" of curated cannabis strains, explaining the entourage effect and matching the profile to the guest's desired mood.

Bio-Optimized Atmosphere: The environment is engineered for nervous system regulation. This includes circadian-aligned ambient lighting, binaural beat or solfeggio frequency background music, and advanced HEPA air filtration so the space remains socially vibrant but impeccably clean and breathable.

The Broader Ecosystem (The Upsell)
The lounge acts as the social magnet. Once patrons experience the immediate benefits of the oxygen and botanical integrations, they are introduced to the core wellness offerings:

The Apothecary (Retail): Adjacent to the lounge, a high-end retail space sells the components guests just enjoyed: premium cannabis flower, functional mushroom tinctures, nootropics,Ormus concentrates,  targeted dietary supplements for daily biohacking etc

The Optimization Seminars: The venue hosts daytime workshops and exclusive evening seminars on epigenetic lifestyle design, ancient botanical medicine, and modern longevity protocols, turning the social space into an educational hub.

The Retreat Pipeline: High-tier clients are funneled into immersive, multi-day restorative retreats hosted at partner locations, where the protocols tested in the lounge are expanded into comprehensive cellular resets.

Global Scalability & Legislation
By anchoring the concept around an Oxygen Bar and functional wellness drinks, the business model can adapt to varying international regulations:

Fully Legal Markets (CA, MA, CO, Uruguay): The lounge can operate at full capacity, serving THC-infused beverages, vapor flights, and retail cannabis alongside oxygen.

Emerging/Medical Markets (Germany, Switzerland, Czech Republic): The lounge can pivot seamlessly to a CBD, CBG, and mycology-focused mixology menu, emphasizing the oxygen therapy, Ormus, and biohacking seminars while remaining fully compliant with local THC limits or pilot-program restrictions.
